title: Havertz escapes red for studs into Ugochukwu's calf
summary: Arsenal led 1-0 through Kai Havertz's header when he lunged studs-up from behind into Lesley Ugochukwu's calf. Paul Tierney showed yellow and VAR James Bell confirmed it. The KMI panel later ruled it should have been a red. Arsenal held on for a win that moved them to within one result of the title.

reactions.quote: The referee's call of a yellow card to Havertz was checked and confirmed by VAR – with the challenge deemed not to be serious foul play.
Criticised the decision not to upgrade the card to red.
